title: Gerrit Plugin Settings
description: Configure connection to your Gerrit Code Review server

gerritUrl.title: Gerrit Base URL
gerritUrl.description: Base URL of your Gerrit server (e.g., https://gerrit.example.com)

gerritUsername.title: Gerrit Username
gerritUsername.description: Your Gerrit username (the same one used to log into Gerrit web interface)

gerritPassword.title: Gerrit HTTP Password
gerritPassword.description: HTTP password or API token (generate in Gerrit Settings > HTTP Credentials)

searchQuery.title: Search Query Pattern
searchQuery.description: Optional: Query pattern to find changes. Use %s as placeholder for issue ID. Examples: message:%s (default), tr:%s (tracking fields), topic:%s. Default: message:%s

showEmptyWidget.title: Show Empty Widget
showEmptyWidget.description: Show the widget even when no related changes are found
